# MPE Gas, Heating, Plumbing & Electrics

> Gas Safe registered boiler repairs, servicing, new boiler installations, plumbing and electrics, covering homes and businesses across the North East of England.

MPE is a family-run trade business. Engineers are Gas Safe registered
(registration number 552052). Same-day response for boiler breakdowns where
possible. The £50 call-out fee is refunded/deducted from the bill once a
repair is carried out — it is not charged on top. Every repair carries a
30-day work guarantee.

Phone: 07448 628 101 (tel:07448628101)
WhatsApp: https://wa.me/447448628101
Email: fergal@mpenortheast.co.uk

Areas served: Newcastle, Gateshead, Gosforth, Whitley Bay, Wallsend, South
Shields, Cramlington, Ashington, Sunderland, Blyth, Morpeth, West Boldon,
Washington, Redcar, and the wider North East of England.

## Services

- [Boiler Repairs](https://mpenortheast.co.uk/boiler-repair): Same-day boiler repair, £50 call-out refunded when fixed, 30-day guarantee, all major brands (Worcester Bosch, Vaillant, Baxi, Ideal, Glow-worm).
- [Boiler Servicing](https://mpenortheast.co.uk/servicing): Annual boiler service from £79, keeps manufacturer warranty valid, full Gas Safe certificate.
- [New Boiler Installation](https://mpenortheast.co.uk/new-boilers): Free no-obligation quotes, fixed price, manufacturer's warranty, old boiler removed.
- [Commercial Services](https://mpenortheast.co.uk/commercial): Commercial gas appliances, catering equipment, EICR and gas safety certification, maintenance contracts, priority call-outs.
- [Plumbing and Electrics](https://mpenortheast.co.uk/): Leaks, taps, bathrooms, fuse boards, rewires, EV chargers — part of the full trade offering alongside heating.

## Advice & guides

- [Advice & Guides index](https://mpenortheast.co.uk/blog): Boiler advice written by MPE's Gas Safe engineers.
- [Why is my boiler losing pressure?](https://mpenortheast.co.uk/blog/why-is-my-boiler-losing-pressure): Common causes and when to call an engineer.
- [Boiler making strange noises?](https://mpenortheast.co.uk/blog/boiler-making-strange-noises): What banging, gurgling and whistling noises usually mean.
- [My boiler won't turn on](https://mpenortheast.co.uk/blog/boiler-wont-turn-on): Safe checks to run before booking a callout.
- [Why annual boiler servicing matters](https://mpenortheast.co.uk/blog/why-annual-boiler-servicing-matters): Warranty, safety and cost reasons to service every year.
- [Signs you need a new boiler](https://mpenortheast.co.uk/blog/signs-you-need-a-new-boiler): Age, repair frequency, and other signs it's time to replace.
